name: hdf5
description: HDF5 is a data model, library, and file format for storing and managing data
$comment: This manifest matches the HDF5 port in Axom's pinned vcpkg revision.
It removes szip from default-features to avoid the unreliable libaec download in Windows CI.
The szip feature remains available for callers that explicitly request it.
$comment_default_features: Upstream defaults are ["szip", "zlib"]; Axom keeps only zlib enabled by default.

mirror.description: Build the Mirror Virtual File Driver

szip.$comment: Opt-in only because the libaec source download has been unreliable in Windows GitHub Actions.
